name: Fulfill or approve a request
intent: Approve or fulfill through the approval and request engines.
procedure: Load REQ/RITM by number. Show variables, price, requested_for, policy.
Approve / reject via Approval Engine only. Never patch approval state.
Fulfill only fields and catalog tasks the item's flow expects.
sideEffects: records the approval decision via the Approval Engine and updates fulfiller fields on RITM/tasks

prompts: Fulfill RITM0012345 for the new laptop.
Reject the request REQ0012345 and tell me why.
